chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: “Whoever drinks wine, then flog him; if he returns, then flog him; and if he returns a third time, then kill him.”
365-22 — From him, from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام:

key_terms.الثَّالِثَةَ: the third time; the third recurrence of the act
key_terms.الْخَمْرَ: wine; the intoxicating drink mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.فَإِنْ عَادَ: if he returns; if he repeats the offense
key_terms.فَاجْلِدُوهُ: flog him; impose the prescribed corporal punishment
key_terms.فَاقْتُلُوهُ: kill him; execute him upon the stated repeated offense
key_terms.مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ: the like of that; an equivalent wording or ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the hadith ruling on repeated wine-drinking in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal punishment for drinking wine and for repeated return to the offense. It also records a parallel report from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام affirming the same ruling.
